mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a comfortable 66 degrees under clear skies with a beautiful full moon visible near the Verona Public Library.

In city news, please be advised that road surface treatments are scheduled from August 4 to August 7, starting on Lincoln Street. Also, the city offers a 100 dollar rebate program for residents who replace older toilets with high-efficiency models or install rain barrels.

There is plenty to do this week! Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can visit the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school, join the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, or browse the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison.
Looking at the weekly police report, on July 26, an officer responded to a hit-and-run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, where the driver was eventually identified and cited.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
